subject: Pilot support options: stipend vs rolling discount — Catalyst pilot
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@catalyst.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Catalyst Procurement <procurement@catalyst.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot: runway and discount options (SOW attached)

Hi Soojin / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency and the KV-cache behavior for our chat flows. We’re near the end of the 30-day pilot and have two asks from product and procurement before we decide on conversion:

1) Product would like an extra 2 weeks to run integration tests (can you do a time extension?).
2) Procurement asked whether you can provide either a one-time stipend (credit applied to the pilot invoice) or a small rolling discount (e.g., 8–12%) that would apply if we commit to a 3-month usage minimum after the pilot.

Attached the SOW we used for the pilot (SOW_v1.pdf) and a brief test plan. Can you confirm what options are on the table and any approval steps that slow us down? We need internal approvals by Tues 24 Nov.

Best,
Priya
Head of Product, Catalyst AI

Attachment: SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 1 page stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@catalyst.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Catalyst Procurement <procurement@catalyst.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot: runway and discount options (SOW attached)

Hi Priya — appreciate the clear ask and the SOW.

Short answer: yes, we can do a short runway extension and we have flexible commercial levers. Outline below so you can take it to your stakeholders:

- Time extension: 14 additional days, same pilot environment and instance sizing, no extra charge.
- Stipend (credit): one-time pilot credit applied to your next invoice; standard sizes we’ve used recently are $3k–$7k depending on pilot scale — we can propose $5k for Catalyst based on current burn.
- Rolling discount: conditional discount on per-token rates that only applies if you convert to a 3-month minimum commit within 30 days of pilot end. Typical range: 7–12% depending on commitment tier.

If you want both runway + stipend, we can combine (14 days + $5k credit) but the rolling discount would then be at our mid tier (9%). If procurement prefers the discount only (no stipend), we can push to 10% for a standard 3-month minimum.

Next steps:
- Kimberly, can you confirm pricing approval matrix (need to know whether 10% requires sales lead approval vs. VP)?
- Priya, if this looks acceptable I’ll draft a one-page amendment and a pilot-offer PDF and share a DocuSign link.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call if useful.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Mid-Market Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pilot_offer_catalyst.pdf (application/pdf, 2 page stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot: runway and discount options (internal)

Soojin / Dev,

Quick internal note on approvals:
- Up to 8% discount can be approved by SDR/AE with finance notification.
- 9–12% requires Sales Lead sign-off + Legal review for amendment language (we need to ensure SLA/usage floors are explicit).
- Stipend credits <$6k are fine under standard pilot concession budget; above that needs Sales Ops sign-off.

Given Catalyst's usage profile (they peaked at ~45 concurrent tokens/minute in the test), I recommend:
- Offer the 14-day free extension + $5k stipend (falls within Concession budget), and
- Offer a 9% rolling discount if they sign a 3-month commit within 30 days.

This gives them immediate runway and a visible conversion incentive without escalating. Dev — please confirm we can keep the current pilot cluster unchanged for +14 days and confirm any operational cost exposure.

-Kimberly
GM, North America Sales

[Internal: do not forward without legal redaction]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@catalyst.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Catalyst Procurement <procurement@catalyst.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot: runway and discount options (final offer)

Hi Priya — thanks for the rapid turnaround. Following internal review, here’s the consolidated offer we can put on paper today: 

1) Runway: +14 calendar days to your existing pilot (no additional charge).
2) Stipend: $5,000 pilot credit applied to your post-pilot invoice.
3) Conversion incentive: 9% rolling discount on generation token rates if Catalyst signs a 3-month minimum commit within 30 days after the pilot end. Discount applies to the committed tier only and is subject to a standard amendment (SLA and usage floor included).

I’ve uploaded the one-page amendment and pilot-offer to our shared drive and started a DocuSign envelope so procurement can sign the amendment quickly: https://drive.redwood.company/drive/folders/1a2b3cSOW-Catalyst and DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/sign/xyz-POC-offer

If that works, please reply with approval and I’ll send the formal amendment for signature. If procurement wants to prioritize a straight discount without a stipend, we can move to 10% (would need Sales Lead sign-off).

Scheduling: I have a 30-min slot Thu 26 Nov 09:00–09:30 PT if you want to run the proposed wording by your security/procurement folks.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Catalyst onboarded.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Mid-Market Sales
Redwood Inference
